name: pk-library-row-reductions
title: PK the library: high-perf MLIR row-reduction codegen vs real liger/xformers Triton kernels
creator: kingdom
notes: Pivot from the off-target fusion direction to the real bar (head-to-head vs the library's OWN kernel, same op, high-perf MLIR from intent via the real toolchain). Machinery built + proven on the row-reduction family: rms_norm (1 reduce), softmax (2: max,sum), layer_norm (2: mean,var +affine). All PK the REAL liger kernel at kernel-only PARITY, bit-faithful ~1e-7, and are GENERATED from the IntentFunction (backend/rowreduce_codegen.py: recognize -> 1 high-perf kernel, vs naive 8-9 kernels that fail ptxas). See corpus/PERF_PK_SUMMARY.md. Remaining 20-kernel dataset (group_norm/poly_norm/losses reuse the reduction codegen; swiglu/geglu = activation/fusion; rope/mrope = position-embedding family; xformers/flash = attention family) is the breadth follow-on now that depth is proven.
